name: reels-editor
description: Single-window WYSIWYG Reels editor (Player + timeline + transitions) over the ReelsRemotion engine.
comment: All runtime deps (react, react-dom, remotion, @remotion/*) resolve from the repo-root node_modules so the editor and the embedded <Player> share one React/Remotion instance. Vite tooling is installed at the repo root too.
